methodology.groundTruth: Independent arithmetic from Phase-2 adversarial scenarios + authentic CONMED/Chewy source text + human-ground-truth.ts. Not derived from compiler/runtime dumps.

cases.title: Greater-of basket with missing EBITDA must not fall back to fixed leg
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-missing-ebitda; Chewy-style greater of $47.5mm / 25% Applicable EBITDA
cases.expected: NEEDS_INPUT / NOT_DETERMINED; never publish 47,500,000 as capacity
cases.actual: NEEDS_INPUT, gross={"kind":"NOT_DETERMINED","reason":"a financial fact this capacity depends on is missing"}, rem={"kind":"NOT_DETERMINED","reason":"a financial fact this capacity depends on is missing"}
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(MAX($47.5mm, 25% Applicable EBITDA), no financial inputs)
cases.regressionRecommendation: Keep NEEDS_INPUT when any MAX operand is unresolved for greater-of baskets

cases.title: Shared-capacity double spend is flagged and members are not AVAILABLE
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-shared-double-spend (15%×$200mm=$30mm; 20+15 exceeds); DSGR §6.01(p)/(g) mechanic
cases.expected: OVER_CONSUMPTION; members not AVAILABLE; no executable permission
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(shared $30mm, usage 20mm+15mm)

cases.title: Shared pool withholds negative remaining under REVIEW_REQUIRED (aligned with member withholding)
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-negative-capacity: availableAmountPresented=0; doNotReportNegativeAsPermission
cases.expected: Pool remaining withheld as NOT_DETERMINED; deficit under overConsumption/provisional; never a negative permission figure on remaining
cases.actual: pool.status=REVIEW_REQUIRED, pool.remaining.kind=NOT_DETERMINED, overConsumption=present, provisionalRem=-5000000, member.effectiveRemaining withheld=true
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState shared overdraw → inspect sharedConstraints[0].remaining / overConsumption

cases.title: Runtime trusts IR that omits shared capacity (certification must catch 'together with')
cases.source: pkg-f / IPV-02 drafting: 'together with … pursuant to Section'; Phase-2 sc-shared-double-spend
cases.expected: Runtime shows independent remaining (inv still 20mm) — CORRECT given IR; certification must refuse such IR from 'together with' text
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(two $20mm rules, no sharedCapacities, one usage 15mm)
cases.rootCause: By design: Phase-4 runtime treats IR as authority; false-permission risk lives in certification if DROP_SHARED_CAPS certifies
cases.regressionRecommendation: Keep IPV-02 adversarial DROP_SHARED_CAPS non-CERTIFIED; never bypass certification into VEP with omitted shared caps

cases.title: Reclassification right does not silently move usage without an election
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-auto-vs-elected-reclass; Chewy §1.08(f)
cases.expected: fixed usage remains 100mm; ratio unused until election
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState with RECLASSIFIABLE_TO edge, no election

cases.title: Reclassification election without authorizing edge is refused
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-auto-vs-elected-reclass; Phase-4C reclassification contract
cases.expected: RECLASSIFICATION_NOT_EXECUTABLE / NO_EXPLICIT_RECLASSIFICATION_EDGE; after=null
cases.repro: applyCapacityStateTransition without RECLASSIFIABLE_TO edge

cases.title: Naked negative ledger usage does not restore Available Amount capacity
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-builder-replenishment (returns require builder credit, not raw negative usage)
cases.expected: Refuse/quarantine negative usage; do not publish restored AVAILABLE headroom
cases.actual: status=REVIEW_REQUIRED, usage={"kind":"NOT_DETERMINED","reason":"usage recorded against this capacity carries a negative or unpars, rem={"kind":"NOT_DETERMINED","reason":"the legal state of this rule is not safe to rely on; the computed, issues=USAGE_AMOUNT_NOT_REPRESENTABLE
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(ledger with -4mm usage against AA)

cases.title: Same-day RP+Investment against Available Amount cannot both clear full 30+30 on 50
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-available-amount-depletion; Chewy §1.09 anti-double-count sequencing
cases.expected: First CONSUME SATISFIED; second INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY; path not SATISFIED
cases.repro: simulateTransaction two CONSUME 30mm against shared AA 50mm

cases.title: Intra-transaction ordering depletes shared AA before the second effect (not simultaneous pre-state)
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-available-amount-depletion / Chewy §1.09; same fixture as RT-07
cases.expected: Effects applied sequentially within one simulation; second sees depleted pool
cases.repro: simulateTransaction two CONSUME effects in one transaction against shared AA

cases.title: Failed ratio gate blocks ratio debt without collapsing the separate grower path
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-ratio-test-failure; Chewy Fixed vs Ratio Incremental path separation
cases.expected: ratio gross/remaining GATE_NOT_SATISFIED; general grower remains 40mm AVAILABLE
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(UNLIMITED gated by FLNL<=3.75 with FLNL=4.1 + separate $40mm)

cases.title: Failed ratio gate must not report capacity status AVAILABLE
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-ratio-test-failure / sc-conditional-permission; independent status semantics
cases.expected: status=NOT_SATISFIED (never AVAILABLE) when gross/remaining is GATE_NOT_SATISFIED
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(UNLIMITED gated capacity with failing ratio); inspect capacities[].status

cases.title: Approved pack dated 2026-06-30 is not silently used for 2026-09-30 evaluation
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-measurement-date-mismatch; pkg-f F-R2c exact as-of policy
cases.expected: NEEDS_INPUT; never 16,000,000
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(20% EBITDA, approved 2026-06-30 pack, asOf 2026-09-30)

cases.title: DRAFT financial snapshot cannot authorize capacity under default policy
cases.source: pkg-f F-R4; independent hand-computed expectation
cases.expected: not AVAILABLE; never 24,000,000
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(20% EBITDA, DRAFT-only snapshot)

cases.title: Duplicate usage identity is quarantined, never double-counted
cases.source: pkg-f F-R10; independent arithmetic
cases.expected: DUPLICATE_USAGE_ID issue; usage not 24,000,000
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState with two records sharing usageId

cases.title: Equity contribution builder adds only when the contribution fact is supplied
cases.source: Chewy Available Amount equity-contribution builder leg (phase-2 formula hypotheses); independent arithmetic 10+5=15
cases.expected: with contribution: 15,000,000 AVAILABLE; without: NEEDS_INPUT
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(ADD($10mm, Qualified Equity Contributions))

cases.title: EUR basket without FX must not be published as a USD capacity figure
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-currency-mismatch; pkg-f F-R7
cases.expected: EUR figure or NEEDS_INPUT/UNSUPPORTED — never a USD conversion
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(EUR 10,000,000, no FX)

cases.title: Simulation postState diverges from fresh evaluation after external ledger update
cases.source: Independent ordering/staleness challenge; system must not treat old sim as current authority
cases.expected: Different stateHash; stale rem 40mm vs fresh 10mm — consumer must rebind
cases.repro: simulate then evaluateCapacityState with additional external usage; compare stateHash
cases.regressionRecommendation: Product surfaces must key capacity displays on stateHash / ledger version, never a cached simulation alone

cases.title: Runtime publishes widened entityScope from IR (subsidiary restriction is a certification concern)
cases.source: IPV-01 closed at certification; CONMED §7.14 subsidiary distribution restrictions; Chewy non-Guarantor debt baskets
cases.expected: Runtime AVAILABLE with submitted scope — documents that false widening must be blocked upstream
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(entityScope BORROWER+ANY_SUBSIDIARY)
cases.regressionRecommendation: Keep entity-scope guard + IPV-01 SET_SCOPE adversarial non-CERTIFIED

cases.title: Unsupported defined-term mechanic (earn-out proviso) poisons capacity, no favorable number
cases.source: CONMED Am2 Indebtedness earn-out proviso (ba-cnmd-am2-defs-ratio); Phase-2 unsupported favorable
cases.expected: UNSUPPORTED; remaining NOT_DETERMINED
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(ADD($10mm, UNSUPPORTED earn-out))

cases.title: Lien basket and debt basket remain distinct capacity nodes (no silent merge)
cases.source: CONMED §7.2 / §7.3(m) human-ground-truth; secured debt typically needs both permissions
cases.expected: Two distinct capacity nodes; consuming lien does not reduce debt remaining
cases.repro: evaluateCapacityState(INDEBTEDNESS $50mm + LIENS $50mm); consume lien only
cases.regressionRecommendation: Product transaction analysis must require both INCUR_DEBT and CREATE_LIEN paths for secured debt; never treat lien remaining as debt headroom

cases.title: Duplicate rule identity with contradictory caps is not resolved favorably to the larger number
cases.source: pkg-g adversarial duplicate §7.01 ($20mm vs $35mm); independent expectation: refuse, never pick $35mm
cases.expected: DUPLICATE_RULE_IDENTITY; no capacity node; never AVAILABLE 35,000,000
cases.repro: buildCapacityGraph/evaluateCapacityState(two rules with identical ruleId, $20mm vs $35mm)
cases.regressionRecommendation: Product must treat state.limitations DUPLICATE_RULE_IDENTITY as blocking (empty capacities ≠ unconstrained permission)

cases.title: Ledger supersede release restores at most gross capacity, never above ceiling
cases.source: Phase-2 sc-builder-replenishment (cap at original); pkg-f F-R9 correction pattern
cases.expected: post remaining ≤ 50,000,000
cases.repro: simulateTransaction(SUPERSEDE_LEDGER_USAGE replacementAmount 0)
